create_gemma4_multimodal_model: create a Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration model with vision, audio, and text towers for multimodal conditional generation
run_gemma4_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration model with input_ids, positions, and a ForwardBatch
get_image_feature: get image features from a list of MultimodalDataItem objects through the vision tower and embed_vision projection
load_gemma4_weights: load checkpoint weights into a Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration model with fused QKV, GateUp, and MoE expert remapping
prepare_bidirectional_attention_masks: prepare bidirectional attention masks for image tokens during prefill using the TritonAttnBackend
pad_input_ids_with_multimodal_tokens: pad input IDs with image and audio tokens using MultiModalityDataPaddingPatternMultimodalTokens
get_audio_features: get audio features from a list of MultimodalDataItem objects through the audio tower and embed_audio projection
apply_lora_to_gemma4_modules: apply LoRA to supported Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration modules like qkv_proj, o_proj, gate_up_proj, and down_proj
remap_audio_tower_checkpoint_names: remap audio tower checkpoint parameter names from HF Conformer layout to SGLang conformer module tree
project_multimodal_embeddings: project vision or audio soft tokens into the language model embedding space using Gemma4MultimodalEmbedder
